exposure: Types of drugs prescribed (analgesics, antimicrobials, anti-ulcer, anti-emetic)
Drug prescription patterns (average drugs per prescription, average antibiotics per prescription, generic drug percentage, national essential medicine list percentage)
outcome: Postoperative drug utilization patterns measured by WHO indicators
cohort: 385 postoperative patients admitted to a hospital's surgery ward, predominantly due to elective lower segment caesarean section.
finding: Polypharmacy, especially with antimicrobial agents, was very common among postoperative patients.
